params.name: dex
params.description: Refer to https://docs.kyberswap.com/kyberswap-solutions/kyberswap-zap-as-a-service/zaps-supported-chains-dexes for list of supported dexes for each chain

params.name: pool.id
params.description: id of the pool to zap into.

params.name: position.id
params.description: id of the position to add liquidity to; omit to create a new uniswapV3 position. for uniswapV2 this is user address

params.name: position.tickLower
params.description: min tick of the position, required if creating a new uniswapV3 position.

params.name: position.tickUpper
params.description: max tick of the position, required if creating a new uniswapV3 position.

params.name: tokensIn
params.description: which token(s) to use as zap source. also accepts comma separated addresses

params.name: amountsIn
params.description: amount(s) to zap including fee, corresponding to tokenIn. also accepts comma separated amounts.

params.name: tokenIn
params.description:
which token(s) to use as zap source. also accepts comma separated addresses.
deprecated: use tokens_in. if both fields are specified, they are combined

params.name: amountIn
params.description:
amount(s) to zap including fee, corresponding to tokenIn. also accepts comma separated amounts.
deprecated: use amounts_in. if both fields are specified, they are combined

params.name: aggregatorOptions.disable
params.description: whether to disable swapping with the aggregator

params.name: aggregatorOptions.includedSources
params.description: comma-separated list of sources to use for aggregator

params.name: aggregatorOptions.excludedSources
params.description: comma-separated list of sources to exclude for aggregator

params.name: aggregatorOptions.excludedPools
params.description: comma-separated list of pools to exclude for aggregator

params.name: feeAddress
params.description: the address of the fee recipient.

params.name: feePcm
params.description:
fee percentage in per cent mille (0.001% or 1 in 100,000). Ignored if feeAddress is empty.
From 0 to 100,000 inclusively. Example: 1 for 0.001%.

params.name: slippage
params.description:
maximum slippage tolerance in basis points (0.01%), used for aggregator (exceeding which the transaction will
revert) and pool swap during zap (for additional zapping and for refund).
From 0 to 10,000 inclusively. Example: 1 for 0.01%.
